title: The scripted research agent holds its dedup claim until its sync ends, so research-shared cannot flake under load
goal: the replayed research agent releases its claim only after its sync to the shared origin ends (plus the hold), so a late dedup of another agent under host load sees the claim and multi fitness case research-shared holds on every run (reviewer of SP-p46hofrg on ST-hur6y3hj g3: the hold runs from the dedup, bench_replay.py PLANT_HOLD, the class of flake BG-cs7uxn7a fixed for land-stop)

run:
import subprocess, sys
for i in range(3):
    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '_tools/benchmarks.py', 'multi', 'fitness', '--case', 'research-shared'], capture_output=True, text=True)
    assert r.returncode == 0, ('research-shared failed on run', i, (r.stdout + r.stderr)[-300:])
